pr_body:
During the `GcScanRoots` routine we were indicating a `TypedReference` was passed by reference to all managed callers. This means that it would be tracked incorrectly across managed method calls.

Related https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/71675

Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/71890

/cc @jkotas @davidwrighton

My guess is that this is fallout from #71498 that has to do reporting of the `TypedReference` `ref` field.

@AaronRobinsonMSFT Could you please take a look?
@jkotas I'm unable to reproduce this on an M1. Did you reproduce this on an x64?
Yes, I have reproduced it on x64. It does not repro on Windows. I have not tried Linux x64.
I can get it to fail on Linux x64 (i.e., `222 != -1`), but I've not been able to see the assert fire.
I've found the issue and am now tracking down all the needed changes. This is related to how we pass `TypedReference` around and report the byref field to the GC.
